The '''Battle of Shindra's Veil''' was the climactic [[Space warfare/Legends|naval engagement]] of the [[Unification War]], [[Shey Tapani]]'s campaign to unite the [[Twelve Kingdoms]] of the [[Expanse]] under one banner. Tapani commanded 150 [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at the battle against the [[Rogue Houses]] in [[Shindra's Veil]] in [[7328 BBY]], and the battle brought an end to the war before Tapani founded the [[Tapani Empire]]. Thousands of years later, the [[Unification Gala]] celebrated the battle with a reenactment.
